correctness.rationale: Independent enumeration of all 3^9 edge states produced the exact face vector (18,126,432,729,486), agreeing with lambda(lambda+6)(lambda+3)^4 from the matrix-forest theorem. Replaying the lexicographic element matching on all 1791 nonempty faces gave 855 matched pairs and exactly one critical 0-face plus 80 critical 4-faces. A direct topological sort of all 6894 oriented Hasse covers verified acyclicity. Thus the Morse CW complex has one vertex and only 80 four-cells, hence is their wedge.
